premises.text: RedBeacon lets consumers request local services and book online with price quotes and appointment times for transparency and convenience
premises.evidence_span: a website where you can request virtually any kind of local service

premises.text: Charge service providers only when a consumer books and work is done—full pay-for-performance eases marketplace chicken-and-egg
premises.evidence_span: we're only going to charge businesses if a consumer books the job with them and actually does work

premises.text: Consumers need richer trust info before booking: friends/family, references, web ratings/reviews, background checks—so product must be more social
premises.evidence_span: consumers actually needed a lot more information than we thought they would before they'll book a job online

premises.text: Geographic expansion beyond Bay Area pilot (e.g., Seattle) with high-quality provider acquisition
Embeddable widget distributes the provider network to any site with customizable occupations/look and generous revenue share
premises.evidence_span: creating an embeddable widget which basically makes our high-quality service provider network available to any website

premises.text: Partner media sites can mark recommended providers and get dashboards of requests/jobs/revenue
premises.evidence_span: this is an advertiser or this is a service provider that we personally recommend

value.text: Easy, transparent online booking of local services with trusted providers
value.evidence_span: increase the price transparency and make it very easy to schedule jobs online

causal_links.evidence_span: that's why we think it was really easy to sign up service providers

makes our high-quality service provider network available to any website

notes: TC50 winner/fundraising/bootstrap lesson mostly traction/process—bootstrap coded only insofar as product-iteration framing; funding excluded (§4.2). Three lessons: pay-for-performance, trust info, and scale readiness—last is process not premise. Widget customization demo cascade folded into widget premise. Media partner names are traction evidence for widget GTM. Singleton D2: geo expansion independently revisable module. Anti-template: marketplace core, geo, widget GTM separately revisable.
